hero.headline: Temporary Voice Channels
hero.description: Give your users total control. Think of it as a voice channel that only exists when someone actually needs it. When a user joins a <highlight>Join to Create</highlight> channel, Horizon spins up a private room. Once everyone leaves, it's gone.

features.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to manage voice channels with ease. What is free, will be free. Forever.

items.title: Instant Voice Channels
items.description: The moment a user joins a Join to Create channel, Horizon spins up a private room in milliseconds. No waiting, no manual setup required.

items.title: Automatic Cleanup
items.description: Once everyone leaves, the channel is automatically deleted. No leftovers, no clutter. Your channel list stays clean without any intervention.

items.title: Zero Configuration
items.description: Set up a single <highlight>Join to Create</highlight> channel and Horizon handles the rest. No complicated configs, no permission headaches. It just works.

items.title: Your room, your rules.
items.description: Rename it, lock it, kick people out. The [panel](/docs/panel) puts everything in your hands. Prefer [slash commands](/docs/control-channel)? Those work too.

items.title: Configure it once, forget it.
items.description: Set default permissions, control who can rename or kick, restrict access to mods only. Everything is per-generator, so different channels can have different rules. [Easy setup with /setup](/docs/quickstart).

items.title: Save your setup, reuse it anytime.
items.description: Got a go-to channel setup? [Save it to a slot](/docs/session) and load it back whenever you need it. Up to three profiles per user, ready when you are.

items.title: You don't have to do it alone.
items.description: Promote up to seven trusted members to [channel moderators](/docs/mod) right from Discord. They can kick, block, manage the trusted list, and invite. They never take ownership, and all assignments clear automatically when the channel closes.

items.title: Know what's going on, instantly.
items.description: Horizon posts short [activity logs](/docs/features#in-channel-log-for-members) right inside your channel. Joined, left, claimed, transferred. Everyone in the room sees exactly what's happening, no external bot needed. Server admins can configure which events to track.

items.title: Still not convinced?
items.description: There's plenty more under the hood. Take a look at our [full documentation](/docs) for everything Horizon can do.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about Horizon.

items.question: What is a Join to Create Discord bot?
items.answer: A Join to Create bot creates a new voice channel the moment a user joins a designated trigger channel. With Horizon, users join one channel and instantly get their own private room, no admin action needed. Once everyone leaves, the channel deletes itself automatically.

items.question: How do I automatically create voice channels in Discord?
items.answer: Invite Horizon, run /setup to designate a Join to Create channel, and Horizon handles everything from there. Every user who joins that channel gets a temporary private voice channel created for them in milliseconds.

items.question: Is Horizon completely free?
items.answer: Yes, completely free. Temporary voice channels, automatic cleanup, user permissions, session profiles, and per-channel moderation are all free and will stay free forever.

items.question: Is Horizon really free forever?
items.answer: The core features are and will stay free, and free users will keep getting updates. A premium tier is planned for the future with extra perks, but everything that is free today will remain free. That's a promise.

items.question: Is Horizon reliable? What about uptime?
items.answer: Horizon runs on Kubernetes with multiple replicas, so if one instance goes down another picks up immediately. The database is PostgreSQL managed by CloudNativePG, running in a high-availability setup with streaming replication and automated backups. The whole stack is deployed via GitOps and monitored continuously. No single point of failure, no manual restarts.

items.question: Can I control who manages my temporary voice channel?
items.answer: Absolutely. The channel owner can rename it, set a user limit, lock it, kick and block members, and promote up to seven trusted moderators, all from Discord's native UI or Horizon's slash commands.

footer.description: Horizon is the easiest way to manage voice channels on Discord. Temporary rooms that appear when needed and vanish when done. Everything is configurable in Discord.
